_description: Expiry markdown policy — approved by Leke 2026-07-17 (sliver rule + reorder-level cutover added 2026-07-17). Used by reconcile_published.py. Tiers: days-to-expiry thresholds (inclusive upper bound) mapped to markdown fraction. Floor: Shopify price never drops below the item's purchase_rate (cost); floored items are flagged for disposal review. Prices round to the nearest rounding_step naira. Expired items are pulled to DRAFT on Shopify and listed for disposal. sliver_threshold: a short-dated batch smaller than this fraction of on-hand stock does NOT drive the listing's markdown; its units are flagged for disposal/offline sale instead, and the next batch drives pricing. Expired batches on a shelf that still has live batches never pull the listing; they are flagged for stock adjustment.
